chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Claude Hopkins offers a job; Harry Edison goes to St. Louis
summary: Hopkins wants Mosley for his band; Mosley first helps Jeter and Pillars hold their St. Louis job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Okay, we'll jump back to Cleveland.
Now we get to the start of the Jeter Pillars band, that same guy, Scarpelli down in St. Louis who had the Plantation wanted them to come in and you came in with the band.
You see how that happened, I was playing there in the Furnace and Claude came in and asked me to join the band immediately.
Obviously now he could afford to pay some money.
He was still a name band.
Oh, he was big. I was very happy over that.
You wanted to get up in the world.
I was only making $12 a night. I made a few tips but it didn't amount to much.

But anyway, Claude came to me and I said, well, I'll tell you, I want to give these boys a notice, I've been with them for years and he said I got an idea. I just left St. Louis and there's a guy down there that needs a band. He said I can call him and tell him I've got a band for him. I said if you do that, instead of me joining you right now, you let me know what your schedule will be two weeks from now and I'll go down and stay with them so that they can hold a job and that's when Harry Edison went down with us too.
He stayed with Jeter Pillars then.
Right. He stayed and I just went down and--
So in other words, you just went and--
